column1: # Retrieval and memorization gate, panel wave, lane 08: stability refits over the frozen
# 33-arm unconditioned roster, retaining per-group errors on both declared supports.
# Fitting only over artefacts that already exist, so every row is a CPU row and no card is
# requested or touched. Each cell first reproduces its arm's admitted fit on the unfiltered
# support -- row identity, fold identity, support counts, design widths, selected ridge
# penalties and every whole-support increment -- and only then evaluates the same fitted
# predictions again with the declared insertion/deletion cycles removed. The filter is never
# applied before that gate and the gate is never relaxed for it.
# The roster is the whole panel rather than the five arms carrying the first-order likelihood
# finding, so a stratum-restricted gain in an arm with no whole-support gain is detectable
# rather than invisible by construction. Those five stay identified as the targeted follow-up.
# One cell per slot: the queue admits at most one CPU row per slot, so a lane's cells run in
# sequence and lanes run concurrently. Every lane basename is distinct, because the queue
# derives its status file and its lock from the basename.
# slot key gpu stage label env expect args
